The width in pixels of a mode from the list of 3D modes. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no way to ask a 3D mode for its size, other than [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth) for the same number. A mode number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
@param mode  Number of the mode, 1 to [CountGfxModes3D](CountGfxModes3D).
@returns The width in pixels.
